reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
       CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs') THEN 'TV & Video' ELSE c.parent_category END AS parent_category
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON LOWER(c.category_name) = LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw))
WHERE p.category_id IS NULL
